Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 9  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Richard Bartlett (director of Slim Carter, born in 1922) was born earlier than B. S. Ranga (director of Thendral Veesum, born in 1917). The error occurred because the Planner failed to correctly compare the birth years of the two directors. It incorrectly stated that Richard Bartlett was born first, even though B. S. Ranga (born in 1917) was actually born earlier than Richard Bartlett (born in 1922). This mistake led to the incorrect conclusion that Slim Carter was the film associated with the director born first, instead of Thendral Veesum.
